user.title: Connect to Athlon Groendus
user.description:
Enter the login details you use on the Groendus charging portal (thuisladen.groendus.nl).

Portal URL: change this if your portal moves to another address.
Label: the tenant your account belongs to. Leave empty to derive it from the portal URL (thuisladen.groendus.nl → groendus).

Note: Home Assistant will store these credentials in the config entry so it can refresh data.
